canvas_dag.edge_contract: canvas.edge.add rejects self-edges, missing endpoints, duplicate directed edges, and every cycle before mutation.
canvas_dag.layout_contract: Deterministic topological layers preserve node dimensions, use bounded gaps, own one atomic undo snapshot, and refuse invalid graphs.
canvas_dag.z_order_contract: Board paint order is the boardNodes array; canvas.node.bring_to_front moves a node to the array tail (idempotent when already front) and owns one atomic undo snapshot.
canvas_dag.execution_boundary: Canvas executes supported image, video, and audio nodes through durable provider jobs; note/frame nodes pass context, media-backed nodes are cached, and unsupported arbitrary code is never evaluated.
canvas_dag.section_contract: Board sections are observeable lanes; add/update/remove own one atomic undo snapshot; assign_section sets or clears node.section_id (null clears); removing a section orphans member nodes.

preview.auto_resolution: Use the active Canvas or Video workspace; from 3D Stage choose Video when time_sec or clips exist, otherwise Canvas.
preview.time_semantics: time_sec renders an exact Video timeline time; when omitted, Video keeps a meaningful in-clip playhead or deterministically chooses a high-visibility interior frame from the earliest visible clip.
preview.concurrency_semantics: expected_snapshot_fingerprint is checked before and after rendering; a concurrent change rejects the capture.

timebase.rate_contract: exact rational numerator/denominator; never infer an integer from fps
timebase.timecode_contract: SMPTE HH:MM:SS:FF for NDF and HH:MM:SS;FF for DF

offline_relink.execution_surface: director_creative media.relink plus Assets panel file picker
offline_relink.reason: Relink accepts inline bytes, Gallery media_id, or workspace_path; the Assets panel file picker remains available for humans.

gallery.reason: Permanent deletion removes durable browser media and requires confirm:true; trash/restore remain the reversible path.

interchange.agent_transfer: enabled for bounded inline, Gallery media_id, and workspace_path imports/exports up to 8 MiB
interchange.reason: JSON receipts carry UTF-8 text or base64 binary up to 8 MiB. Import uses plan-import then confirm:true import; the human file picker remains available.

collaboration.agent_transfer: enabled through a dedicated Director Agent identity in the exact Yjs room
collaboration.reason: The Agent joins the target room as its own collaborator. Destructive restore/delete require confirm:true.

pipeline.failure_semantics: A failed node blocks only its descendants; independent branches continue, active provider jobs are cancelled on request, and completed outputs keep node/job/artifact/media lineage.

recommended_loop: observe when current node, media, track, or clip ids are needed
use execute_batch for one complete user intent, or execute for one edit
use preview or audit only when the user asks for a visual check or diagnosis
configure generation nodes, then use pipeline start, status, or cancel by run id
